authorization: Human requested planning and item-wise implementation; local code and synthetic tests only. No new account decision, model role, Train experiment or batch is authorized by this repair plan.
attribution: User-directed Supervisor H engineering, not agent-originated R/H evolution.
observed_problem: The real price entry completes C experiments but does not execute R/H proposals. Operational failures and timings are not supplied as usable Controller evidence; accepted capacity versions are not resolved by the live entry.
research_reuse: Reuse the existing seven-stage driver, once-only account roles, native worker, frozen five-minute task/scorer, independent reviewer, capacity identity/activation and journals. No new scientific method, literature retrieval or data acquisition.
protected: fees, data permissions and hard caps

items.change: Persist compact timing evidence, actual execution accounting, configured R/H pair and fixed implementation capability descriptor in the existing history/overhead. Missing measurements stay unknown. Do not transfer raw rows, stderr or unreviewed error text.
items.acceptance: Next synthetic Controller input contains the previous observed stages and independently reviewed failure outcome, while identical rows/scoring, byte cap, no-retry and replay remain unchanged.
items.not_claimed: Pre-author implementation failure continuation remains F5; this item does not activate R/H or prove capacity benefit.
verification: stage timing provenance and invalid/symlink timing rejection
failed worker is invalid prediction evidence
two-round continuation, KEEP, restart, cap, byte and boundary regressions
items.rollback: New source checkpoint reverting only F1; old batch accounting/history never rewound

items.change: Add a prospective versioned C/R/research-H action contract and matched input review. Preserve the old v1 path. Stop forcing every decision to be a prediction recipe; do not force R/H mutations either.
items.acceptance: Typed capacity proposals cite current evidence and exact parent/scope/test/downstream use; malformed/protected/authority-changing proposals fail before role calls or fit reservations.
items.checkpoint_split: Protocol/prompt and reviewer changes are separate bounded checkpoints; no broad all-files change.

items.change: Reuse existing role transport for bounded author output and distinct review; test old/new reviewed R or research-tool H on the same inputs; call existing CapacityActivation.propose/review/resolve/rollback rather than build another gate or registry.
items.acceptance: Separate exact source review and observed benefit evidence; rejected/untested changes never activate; original proposal/source/failed output persists. Source-generated code requires reviewed bounded execution, not unrestricted resolve/import.

items.change: Install the real capacity adapter in build/preflight; dispatch typed operations through existing stages. Check operation-specific authorized resource consumption without new ledger, silent free operations or enlarged caps.
items.acceptance: Actual hook invocation and source/output bindings, not hash-only metadata; persistent selected versions survive restart; trusted kernel/driver/permission drift still rejects.
items.checkpoint_split: Dispatch, quota binding and downstream hook use are separate bounded checkpoints.

items.change: Reviewed certain failures become evidence for a new original Controller decision and fresh action, never retry the old operation. Preserve the generic driver's uncertain-claim stop. Reuse applicable failure receipt validation rather than fabricate worker receipts for pre-author failures.
items.acceptance: Valid negative, known implementation failure, rejected capacity, interrupted/uncertain execution, restoration and cap exhaustion have distinct transitions and preserved accounting.

items.change: Verify one official-entry vertical path and exact protected-source diff. Independently review the integrated snapshot before prospective activation. Only a fresh applicable whole-role experiment grant may launch live Controller/author/reviewer calls and Train fits.
items.acceptance: Synthetic engineering path first; then a separately authorized real proposal/test/version/downstream-use trace. Report engineering pass separately from real co-evolution and matched-budget superiority.

work_rules: One bounded component and exact write scope per source checkpoint; over two production modules or about 200 changed lines requires splitting or explicit independent inseparability review. Preserve all meaningful failures and source/result checkpoints. No parallel mutation of shared source; no subagents dispatched in this plan.
completion: This plan is not delivery. Item results must contain actually run commands/tests and explicit remaining limitations; no synthetic test is called a real scientific cycle.
